# API endpoint discovery from decorator patterns

The analyzer recognizes FastAPI- and Flask-style route decorators on definitions and emits api_endpoint_observed facts with method, route, handler, and source. It uses textual matching of decorator nodes to extract route paths and HTTP methods and anchors the discovered endpoints to the source file location.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/extractors/python_analyzer.py` — `knowledge_compiler.extractors.python_analyzer.PythonAnalyzer._routes`
